instruction: There's a directory on my desktop named "project_draft_v1". Could you rename it to "project_draft_v2"?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from 'project_draft_v1' to 'project_draft_v2'. Evaluator checks if the renamed directory exists using shell command. This variation uses a version number pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both conditions required for a rename operation
Command checks that new directory 'project_draft_v2' exists: [ -d ~/Desktop/project_draft_v2 ]
Command checks that old directory 'project_draft_v1' no longer exists: [ ! -d ~/Desktop/project_draft_v1 ]
Both conditions are properly combined with AND logic (&&) to ensure complete verification
The evaluator will correctly fail if agent only creates new directory without removing old one
The evaluator will correctly fail if agent only removes old directory without creating new one
Expected value 'Renamed successfully.\n' matches the success output from the compound command
